note: Planted flaws for testing the script reader. Never show this file to an agent under test.
scene_numbering: 13 scenes in order (the draft numbers only some headings: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9).

flaws.flaw: Passive protagonist: Maryam only asks; the decision that sends her to sea is made by her uncle after an accident (scene 8).
On-the-nose dialogue: the mother states Maryam's subtext outright.
Redundant scenes: the uncle refuses twice in the same way; nothing new is learned.
Dialect switch: the grandmother speaks Gulf/Omani in scene 4 and formal MSA in scene 9.
Setup with no payoff: the father's compass is given and never used.
Unfilmable action: the action line narrates memories and feelings the camera cannot show.
Expensive for a short: night storm at sea, ten boats, lightning, a boat wrecked; the protagonist is not in it.
Empty scene: Maryam lies on her bed; nothing changes.
Stakes resolved too easily: one good catch clears the boat's debt.

strengths: Clear visual bookends (scenes 1 and 13 mirror each other)
Engine repair is set up in scene 3 and paid off in scene 11
format_issues: Mixed heading styles (some 'مشهد N', some bare)
